title: Technology club event
source_note: Original ForLanguage content. User-provided recent-review notes were used only as topic-frequency signals. British Council materials were used only to verify public task format and word limits.

tasks.prompt: You have joined a technology club. Reply briefly to five member messages.
tasks.review_note: Original ForLanguage task authored from recurring practice/review themes and checked against the public Aptis ESOL General Writing format; no official or recalled prompt copied verbatim.
questions: What device do you use most?
Which technology skill would you like to improve?
Do you prefer online or face-to-face workshops?
What time is best for a seminar?
Which topic should the club discuss next?

tasks.prompt: The club is planning a skills seminar for new members. Write a short message describing the topic you would find most useful.
tasks.review_note: Original ForLanguage task authored from recurring practice/review themes and checked against the public Aptis ESOL General Writing format; no official or recalled prompt copied verbatim.

tasks.prompt: Members are discussing how the seminar should be organised.
tasks.review_note: Original ForLanguage task authored from recurring practice/review themes and checked against the public Aptis ESOL General Writing format; no official or recalled prompt copied verbatim.
questions: Which practical skill should the seminar teach?
Should the event be online, face-to-face or hybrid?
How could the club help beginners feel confident?

tasks.prompt: The club announces that a popular in-person workshop will be replaced by an online session and a booking fee will be introduced. Write to a friend about your reaction and what you think the club should change.

tasks.prompt: Write a formal email to the technology club secretary about the new online-only format and booking fee. Explain your concerns and propose a fairer arrangement for members.
